'''Chief Linguist''' was a position. At one time, it was held by [[Jorus Trass]] at the [[Almas Academy|Almas Jedi Academy]], who studied the [[Tarasin]] [[Tarasin Skintone Language|skintone language]]. [[Arner Figgis]] was Chief Linguist at the [[University of Be'nal]] on [[Issor]].
